name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A Popover and Calendar composition for controlled ISO date selection.

files.content:
<aevko-popover [id]="id() + '-popover'" [label]="label()" [(open)]="open" align="start"
  ><button
    aevkoPopoverTrigger
    type="button"
    data-slot="date-picker-trigger"
    [attr.aria-label]="display() + ', ' + label()"
    [disabled]="isDisabled()"
    (blur)="touch()"
  >
    {{ display() }}</button
  ><aevko-calendar
    data-slot="date-picker-calendar"
    [label]="label()"
    [(month)]="month"
    [value]="value()"
    [min]="min()"
    [max]="max()"
    [disabled]="isDisabled()"
    (valueChange)="select($event)"
/></aevko-popover>
